title.zh: 共同负担要求共同发言

desc.zh: 海路护航与边镇驻防的账目摊到本国头上，出钱者要求席位，东明以商路为凭观察议事并提出限制。双方各自独立记下维持、修订或退出，账房据此写成下一辈承接的约定。
desc.en: Sea-lane escorts and border garrisons bill the court; the payers demand seats while Dongming, staking its trade lane, observes the deliberation and proposes limits. Each side independently records maintain, revise, or exit, and the treasurers bind the verdicts into a pact the next generation inherits.

desc.zh: 海路护航与边镇驻防的账目摊到了各省头上。纳税州府与商会联名陈情：既摊共同负担，就须共议席位；是否开放议事给邻国观审，须先定夺。
desc.en: Sea-lane escorts and border garrisons are billed across the provinces. Taxpaying prefectures and merchant guilds petition: a shared burden demands shared seats; the court first decides whether the deliberation opens to an outside observer.

reads: partner reachability and port or trade presence

desc.zh: 商船带回一封大顺的请帖。下回商议护航开支，请东明派人到场旁听。几家出过钱的商行一齐来见官，其中一家带来了上回的摊单。掌柜把纸翻了个面，背面空空的。“每家该出多少，正面都有。大人若问这数是怎么议出来的，叫我到哪一面去找？”
desc.en: A merchant ship brings an invitation from Shun. An envoy from Dongming may sit in when the cost of the escorts comes up for discussion. Several of the houses that have helped pay the bill send men to see the authorities. One brings the last assessment and turns it over. The back is blank. “What each house owes is on the front, sir. If you ask me how they came by those sums, which side am I to look on?”

title.en: Funds for the Post Roads and the Escort Fleet

desc.zh: 驿丞呈上京畿道路的修补清单。掌海运的官员翻出一条旧例，护航船若在本国港口装货，朝廷也能从这笔银子里拨给码头添办人手物料。两处照旧领款的话，这笔钱就留在库里。
desc.en: The postmaster submits the list of roads around the capital that need mending. The shipping office cites an old rule. When escort ships take on supplies at a home port, the treasury can use the same money to hire dockhands and buy stores. If both services keep their usual allowances, the money stays in the treasury.

title.en: When Do the Emergency Powers End

desc.zh: 先前借去运粮的车马，到了日子该拿什么文书来领？出钱的人要把征发权的期限写进约里。营里请留一道余地，若仍在交战，或仍有陆军在动员，准再延一期。
desc.en: The carters want to know what papers will get their teams back when the requisition order expires. Those paying for the pact want an expiry date in writing. The army asks for one extension if the country is still at war or has an army mobilized.
